title: Niagara Falls Tour with Boat Cruise Skylon and Behind Falls
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore Niagara Falls with a local guide on a scenic walking tour that combines iconic attractions, panoramic viewpoints, and insider knowledge of the Falls district. This experience blends storytelling, sightseeing, and some of Niagara’s most famous attractions, including Skylon Tower, Journey Behind the Falls, and Niagara City Cruises. Designed for travelers who want more than just photos, this tour offers a memorable way to experience the history, power, and beauty of Niagara Falls on foot.
